plugins.Author: Ehno
plugins.Name: Starfall Studio
plugins.Punchline: Combined GPose toolkit - posing, animation, camera, and scene tools in one plugin.
plugins.Description:
Starfall Studio - combined GPose toolkit for actor posing, animation control, camera editing, and scene building.
- Actor list with click-to-select
- World-space transform gizmo
- Animation control and pause
- Advanced appearance and wetness editing
- Camera editor (Ktisis-style workflow)
- Bone manipulation with bone tree
- MCDF actor import
- NPC/overworld actor import
- Pose import and export
